dataset: Every committed changed file since the accepted base, excluding only the manifest itself, at one fixed delivery commit. New native trajectories are retained remotely and verified by their declared indexes.
required_checks: Fresh actual HEAD and exact manifest/delivery Git bytes
All declared changed files, no empty or omitted change set
Current and historical captured runtime/tool/input Git identities, plus explicitly classified private staging inputs
Remote native byte hashes and complete JSON/JSONL readability
Original root01 and delayed-ACK native failure preserved; saved correction remains separate
retry_policy: No automatic retry or requeue. Preserve any failure and use a new explicit correction/output before another saved check.
excludes: Private full repository object store: existing source identity and complete history are checked, not copied into the public artifact packet
